verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm, not a software product with a user-facing interface, so getting AI-generated insights from your own data inside the product is a category error for this kind of offering. The Legaltech & ALS page describes the firm's internal use of AI/ML contract review in its own practice. It does not show a client-facing product that generates insights from a user's data, so the exception that would make this axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
